exposure: fertility history (previous artificial abortion, first-time pregnancy status, pregnancy intervals)
outcome: massive vaginal haemorrhage during medical abortion
cohort: The study included 1062 patients with missed miscarriage who underwent medical abortion.
finding: A history of artificial abortion and an amenorrhea duration of > 11 weeks were identified as high-risk factors for massive vaginal bleeding during medical abortion in missed miscarriage patients.
gest_age: Duration of amenorrhea and gestational week were measured, with duration of amenorrhea > 11 weeks identified as a risk factor.
